In the square, p+abs(q)<=pi, so the opposite-sign branch beyond both thresholds contributes only boundary points. The feasible set is exactly abs(x-y)<=pi/3 and x+y<=2pi/3. Its complement is three right triangles with legs pi/6, pi/6, pi/3, giving area pi^2/6. Reuse the final separated-D complete angle-factor and half-plane route. The source h070 printed difference identity plus h064 cofunction/parity derives the symbolic cosine identities under the recorded formula-reuse proof; no narrow numerical h071/h074 scope or new universal synthesis node is forced.
